subject: Billing ownership & commit phasing for Gridline Order Form
body:
From: Alicia Nguyen <alicia.nguyen@gridline.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@gridline.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Billing ownership & commit phasing for Gridline Order Form

Diego —

Thanks for the redlines so far. A few quick items procurement needs confirmed before we can route PO and payment:

- Which legal entity at Redwood will be invoicing Gridline? We have separate legal entities in the US (Gridline Inc) and EU (Gridline Ltd). Our finance team needs invoices that match the paying entity for VAT/tax reconciliation.
- Can invoices be split by tranches on the order form (we expect a 60/40 phasing across two invoices)?
- What net terms are you proposing (net30 vs. net45)? Gridline typically prefers net45 for larger partners but we can circle back.
- We will need Redwood’s VAT registration / tax residency certificate for our AP team and bank details to set up ACH/wire routing.
- Any changes to the tax indemnity or WHT treatment in your redlines? Our tax team flagged the clause with broad indemnities.

Please confirm and attach the latest redline that includes invoice party and invoicing cadence. We want to move to PO by next Tuesday 11/24.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager, Gridline Systems
procurement@gridline.com

---

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Nguyen <alicia.nguyen@gridline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing ownership & commit phasing for Gridline Order Form

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Summary / proposed approach below and attached: OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx.

1) Invoicing party: Redwood prefers to invoice Gridline Inc (US) for the initial tranche. For any EU-resident invoicing or ongoing EU services after go-live, we can invoice Gridline Ltd for subsequent invoices. We will include an explicit "invoicing entity" field on the order form so the party can be swapped per tranche.

2) Invoice split: splitting 60/40 across two invoices is acceptable. We'll mark the schedule in the commercial schedule section and reference tranche IDs in the invoice description.

3) Net terms: Standard is net30. For enterprise customers we can offer net45 on a case-by-case basis tied to a credit approval and signed acceptance of the payment schedule. Propose: net30 by default; Gridline can elect net45 if they provide a PO and credit contact.

4) Tax documentation & bank details: please send VAT registration / tax residency cert and the PO to procurement@redwood.com. We'll provide a bank detail stub on the invoice and can share full wire/ACH info via secure portal.

5) Tax indemnity and WHT: legal has redlined the broad indemnity. Kimberly — see the redlines; we need a short legal position on limiting indemnity to jurisdictional taxes and adding an express WHT gross-up clause where applicable.

Next steps / asks:
- Alicia: confirm intended paying entity for tranche 1 (Gridline Inc vs Gridline Ltd) and attach VAT cert + PO.
- Ben: can you confirm the commercial cadence (60/40) and whether sales wants a holdback/deliverable tie to second invoice?
- Lauren: will finance accept split invoicing for revenue recognition and AR routing? If you need a specific invoice remit address/PO format, flag here.

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx (redlines include invoicing-entity field + tax clause updates).

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Commercial Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing ownership & commit phasing for Gridline Order Form

Diego — quick thoughts:
- 60/40 split works for us from a commercial standpoint. Sales prefers to tie the second tranche to the completion of the onboarding milestone (30 days after production). That gives leverage if post-go-live issues delay payment.
- We should also lock in which SOW or milestone text appears on invoice to avoid disputes (i.e., include tranche ID and milestone phrase).
- I'll own outreach to the Gridline deal sponsor to confirm the PO and expedite credit approval.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing ownership & commit phasing for Gridline Order Form

Team — from finance:
- We can process split invoices. Need clear remit-to and PO number on each invoice. If Gridline wants one PO for both tranches, they must indicate PO references on both invoice submissions to avoid rejection.
- VAT evidence: we need Gridline’s VAT registration for EU invoicing. For US invoicing, we need their EIN or tax ID only if they claim tax-exempt status.
- AR contact: please ask Gridline to provide an AP contact and payment method (ACH or wire).

Kimberly — any blockers from legal on accepting tranche-split and a limited indemnity?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing ownership & commit phasing for Gridline Order Form

Diego / Team — legal notes after reviewing OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx:
- Replace the current indemnity language with a carve-out: Redwood will not indemnify for taxes that are the legal obligation of Gridline under applicable law. We can accept a mutual representation that each party will comply with local tax law.
- Add a WHT clause: if Gridline is required to withhold tax, the parties will work in good faith to gross-up or provide proof of withholding and corresponding credits where required by treaty.
- Limit retroactive claims: any tax reassessment claim must be raised within 180 days after the invoice date.

If procurement needs stronger protection, propose they provide documentary evidence at PO time to avoid broad retro claims.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

---

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Nguyen <alicia.nguyen@gridline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing ownership & commit phasing for Gridline Order Form

Alicia — consolidating decisions and next steps so we can get a PO in place this week: 

Decisions agreed internally:
- Tranche structure: 60% upon signing / invoice 1 (Tranche 1); 40% upon milestone completion (Tranche 2). Sales to confirm milestone wording on invoice.
- Invoicing entity: Redwood to invoice Gridline Inc (US) for Tranche 1. If Gridline requests EU invoicing later, we will create a separate invoice from Redwood’s EU entity for Tranche 2.
- Net terms: net30 by default; Gridline may elect net45 subject to credit approval.
- Tax language: legal has narrowed the indemnity. We will accept mutual compliance language and add a WHT clause with a 180-day window for reassessment claims.

Requested from Gridline (please provide):
1) Confirm paying entity for Tranche 1 (Gridline Inc or Gridline Ltd).
2) Provide PO and PO number (if one PO will cover both tranches, indicate PO references for invoice 1 and invoice 2).
3) Supply VAT registration / tax residency document and AP contact + remit instructions (ACH/wire banking preference).

Attachments: Gridline_PO_Request_20261117.pdf (procurement form we received), OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx (legal redlines reflecting the limited indemnity + WHT clause).

If we have the PO and VAT evidence by EOD Tue 11/30 we can issue Invoice 1 the week of 12/1.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the invoice template once Alicia confirms the paying entity.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Commercial Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415 555 0123

---
